pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with jagged, stellate margins and acute-angled protrusions. Regions in the neck and shoulder area are larger and more complex than the more uniform, smaller patches on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage pathways with primarily triradiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, appearing widest at the shoulder-neck transition and narrowing significantly on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck margin, creating a fine-grained texture against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Punctate, dark-pigmented anomalies clustered on the distal-most visible portion of the neck and the anterior surface of the upper forelimb.
